notes.title: UFO VS BIKINI TO RELEASE AUGUST 3
notes.notes:
In [b]UFO VS BIKINI[/b], we, the aliens drove our spacecraft to earth and began to study the earth. We uses three materials to build: biological materials, mineral materials, and mechanical materials. The spacecraft relies on the emitted light to inhale any material, and uses the ship’s furnace to decompose the items into these three materials, which are used to upgrade the spacecraft.

In the process, we caught some girls on the beach and found that the human brain is very useful and easy to control. We began to study humans and gradually discovered their functions.

Upon release, [b]UFO VS BIKINI[/b] will support the following languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian and Vietnamese.

Wishlist the game now!
